usedFor: TimeRex holds your bookings, and Google Docs logs them when “New Event” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in TimeRex, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each booking is written into a doc tab, so a shared page lists what is on the calendar.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s content, so choose add to keep earlier events.
